messages.author: 55722b727ff2aa49
messages.subject: geom_smooth( fill = ??)
parts:
Hello,

I have a newcomer question. I can't seem to figure out how to get rid
of the grey fill when I use geom_smooth. I tried adding 'fill=' and
using theme_blank(). I can change the fill to other colors, but I
don't understand how to get rid of it altogether.

Example below. I am trying to graph reading academic achievement
(nalt) by Grade.

Apologies for the newcomer question and thank you for your help.

JJ


#Example

require(ggplot2)
require(splines)

nalt.math <- c(192.3,202.7,211.2,217.4,223.4,228.5)
nalt.math.sd1 <- c(192.3 - 11.82, 202.7 - 12.38, 211.2 - 13.54, 217.4
- 14.80, 223.4 - 16.04, 228.5 - 16.69)
nalt.read <- c(190.3,199.1,205.8,211.0,214.8,218.2)
nalt.read.sd1 <- c(190.3 - 14.62, 199.1 - 14.43, 205.8 - 14.22, 211.0
- 14.55, 214.8 - 14.63, 218.2 -14.56)
Grade <- c(3:8)
nalt <- data.frame(nalt.math,nalt.math.sd1,
nalt.read,nalt.read.sd1,Grade)


rhg0.1 <- ggplot(aes(x=Grade,y=reading),data=nalt)
rgh1.1 <- rhg0.1 + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(130, 250)) +
geom_smooth(aes(y=nalt.read.sd1,linetype="NALT"),size=1,data=nalt,
colour="red", linetype=2, fill=theme_blank()) + ylab("Reading") +
geom_smooth(aes(y=nalt.read,linetype="NALT"),size=1,data=nalt,
colour="red", linetype=1, fill=theme_blank(), fill=theme_blank()) +
opts(panel.grid.minor =theme_blank(),panel.grid.major
=theme_blank(),panel.background =theme_blank(),panel.border =
theme_blank(),axis.line =theme_segment(size=.4),
legend.key=theme_blank())
rgh1.1
